candidates.name: Adverse Local Tissue Reaction (ALTR)
support_spans: persistent buttock pain and intermittent electric shock–like sensations radiating down the left leg
a left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with an adverse local tissue reaction, which is a known complication of metal-on-metal hip arthroplasties.

candidates.name: Chronic Bursitis
support_spans: focal tenderness over the posterior buttock and greater trochanter
a diagnosis of greater trochanteric bursitis was made
candidates.why: The patient's initial presentation with focal tenderness over the greater trochanter and response to corticosteroid injection suggests chronic bursitis.
